flags.message: The brief in opposition (docket entry Sep 14 2026) was on the snapshot but not provisioned: documents.json was fetched 2026-07-17, before the BIO existed. I fetched the BIO PDF from the supremecourt.gov link in the snapshot and read it (forward mode). Other predictors in this fan-out may not have, so the common baseline differs on this point.

This docket carries a 'Response Requested' entry (Jul 14 2026) after a waiver, a strong grant signal that the sal-v4 band ('baseline') does not encode and the statpack carries no cut for. My number departs from the band anchor mainly on that signal, priced from general knowledge; a response-requested cut in the statpack would make this class of cell scoreable against a committed rate.
